Move & attack, gives a +2 to attack roll

- Turn object off (DM 8+)

3x ammo usage, attacks equal to Auto score, no MAP until after all attacks are made.

Dive up to 2x (Athletics skill) meters to any nearby area, if diving behind cover, also counts as take cover action. Has to be standing.
In close combat, apply melee skill as negative DM to attack roll.
